notes.title: Demo v0.4.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
✨ Improvements
Mouse wheel zooming is now centered around the mouse cursor instead of the center of the screen, so you can point-and-zoom and it will magnify the area where you are pointing.

Magnify and pan gestures are now supported (e.g. from a MacBook trackpad).
🪲 Bug Fixes
Demolish Everything button is no longer clickable while it is hidden (the keyboard shortcut continues to works regardless of the button visibility).

When going to the settings menu or main menu while Demolish mode is active, the cursor now changes back from the demolish cursor to the regular mouse cursor.
🛠️ Internal Changes
The game engine has been upgraded to Godot 4.4.1, bringing some upstream performance improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo v0.4.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
✨ Improvements
The number of daily delivered parcels is now visible even in Chill Mode.

Cannon and Gravity Well descriptions had their wording updated to better explain what the buildings can and cannot do.

Tutorial has been updated to mention that Freeze buttons also freeze upgrade costs between days.
🪲 Bug Fixes
Font issues on the Steam Deck have been fixed. This involved disabling fallback to system fonts on all platforms, so please let us know if you encounter any other font-rendering issues.

notes.title: Demo v0.4.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
🖼️ Visual Changes
Days now begin and end at noon instead of at midnight -- we have heard your feedback that the lighting and shadows look a lot better during the day and people spend a lot of time in the paused state at the end of one day and the start of another, and of course we would like to present the game in the best light.

Shadow quality was improved, especially on the Arctic Shores biome.

Soft shadow quality can now be configured in the settings.

notes.title: Demo v0.4.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
🪲 Bug Fixes
 ❄️Arctic Shores modifier that makes a building type cheaper (🛷🔨Sledge Hammers) now properly works with other cost-reducing upgrades (sorry, no more free [strike]lunch[/strike] hammers!)

 🛷🔨Sledge Hammers cost reductions are now factored into hammer return previews inside the Shop

notes.title: Demo v0.3.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
✨ Improvements
New Cannon upgrade, Ammozone Prime, lets Cannons load parcels directly from neighboring buildings

Each building and upgrade now has a fancy icon and upgrades have an assigned upgrade type

Building names are now color-coded in the shop

Redundant tooltips were removed from the shop
⚖️ Balancing Changes
Higher Cannon base fire rate (0.6 -> 1.0)

Cannon fire rate increase from Fire at Will is stronger (0.1 -> 0.15)

Cannon upgrade Giddy Gunners weaker (80% -> 50%) but cheaper

Higher Gravity Well base pull speed (0.3 -> 0.5)

Cannon and Gravity Well upgrades are now generally cheaper
🪲 Bug Fixes
Some path finding fixes and optimizations, slight efficiency improvements when multiple parallel parcel paths exist

notes.title: Demo v0.3.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
🪲 Bug Fixes

 Fixed keyboard focus changing abruptly shortly after buying a shop upgrade.

notes.title: Demo v0.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
✨ Improvements

 Enhanced the shop with smoother animations and additional sound effects
 Added helpful tooltips to top-level UI elements (stamp & hammer counters, parcel progress bars)
 New option to show FPS available in Interface Settings for performance monitoring


🪲 Bug Fixes

 Resolved pathfinding issue that could cause parcels to take suboptimal delivery routes even if it was not efficient
